subsystems.name: Audio capture
subsystems.role: picks up the speaker's voice clearly, even in noisy places.

subsystems.name: Speech translation pipeline
subsystems.role: turns speech into text, translates it, and speaks the result in another language.

subsystems.name: Edge compute
subsystems.role: runs the translation models on the earbuds or phone for low latency and privacy.
parts: low-power system-on-chip with neural processing unit

subsystems.name: Connectivity
subsystems.role: links earbuds to a phone or cloud for heavier processing and updates.

subsystems.name: Audio output
subsystems.role: plays the translated voice into the user's ear.

subsystems.name: Power and control
subsystems.role: keeps the earbuds running and lets the user manage conversations.

buildSteps.title: Design the acoustics
buildSteps.detail: Place microphones to capture both the wearer's voice and the other speaker, and tune speakers for clear speech.

buildSteps.title: Train the translation models
buildSteps.detail: Collect and align multilingual speech and text data, then train ASR, NMT and TTS models.

buildSteps.title: Optimise for edge
buildSteps.detail: Compress and quantise models so they run within the earbuds' power and memory budget.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate the electronics
buildSteps.detail: Assemble circuit boards with the system-on-chip, radios, microphones and drivers.

buildSteps.title: Build the earbuds
buildSteps.detail: Fit components into the shell, seal for sweat and dust, and connect the battery.

buildSteps.title: Write firmware and app
buildSteps.detail: Integrate the translation pipeline, Bluetooth pairing, and a companion app for language selection.

buildSteps.title: Test and calibrate
buildSteps.detail: Test in quiet and noisy rooms, with different accents, and fine-tune noise suppression.

buildSteps.title: Ship and update
buildSteps.detail: Release language packs and improve models through over-the-air updates.

prerequisites.why: converts spoken words into text accurately for many languages.
translates text between languages with high fluency.
generates natural-sounding speech from translated text.
runs neural networks on small devices without draining the battery.
connects earbuds to phones and streams audio with minimal delay.

pathway.milestone: earbuds that translate common language pairs with a second or two of delay
pathway.unlocks: basic travel, customer service and informal conversation.

pathway.milestone: better noise handling, multi-speaker conversations, and more languages
pathway.unlocks: reliable business meetings and group discussions.

pathway.milestone: fully on-device translation with near-instant response
near-human accuracy and natural voice preservation
pathway.unlocks: everyday conversation across most languages without friction.
